gen-gf-autour-one-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Every round letter in Autour One gets a clear channel leading in, with no hairline-to-stem shift at all. But Carrois Gothic SC leaves every curve open at its end, so paragraphs move along easily.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-chivo: Each stroke of Autour One holds a single thickness, like drawn cable, with a clear channel leading into every round letter. Chivo packs its lowercase toward the caps, yet text stays open.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-chocolate-classical: Autour One skims along at a single stroke weight, with a clear channel leading into each round letter. Chocolate Classical Sans is a sizable sans-serif with a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-comme: Autour One reads like outlines drawn in one width, with a clear channel leading into every round letter. But Comme brings the smooth read, its curves never clogging and its lowercase filling most of the letter height.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-cossette-texte: Cossette Texte gives its lowercase e a wide-eyed look, with n arches as sturdy as their stems and a prominent x-height. But Autour One handles the bold, expressive moments while the sans below does the steady reading.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-duru-sans: Autour One traces every glyph in a single thickness, with a clear channel leading into each round letter. And Duru Sans gives small letters generous openings, with bodies dominating the line, so paragraphs read modern and clean.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-fresca: Autour One brings bold, expressive display letters, each round one fed by a clear channel and no hairline-to-stem shift. And Fresca backs it up with short ascenders over big bowls, counters staying connected to the space outside.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-funnel-sans: Expressive at heart, Autour One leads each round letter in through a clear channel, with no hairline-to-stem shift. But Funnel Sans holds its stroke widths from stem to curve, its lowercase e opening like a pried clasp.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-gafata: A single-weight outline feel runs through Autour One, with a clear channel leading into each round letter. Gafata wins on its tall band of lowercase beneath short stalks, plus a wide-eyed e.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-geist: Round, bold, unmistakable: Autour One sends a clear channel into every round letter, with no hairline-to-stem shift. Geist keeps a quiet, level beat with no accents of weight, so words read as solid blocks.
